subject: showcase
caption:
Jed and Steph are getting married in Baao this September. Their invitation carries one line at the bottom — a link.

What we notice with every couple: the questions do not stop once the invitations go out. What time is the church. Can I bring my mother. Those used to land in a group chat at eleven at night, and someone had to answer them twice.

Now they land on the page instead. The map opens in one tap, and the count updates as people answer.

Message us your event date and we will show you what yours could look like.
